stages.name: network
stages.claim: on a network, agent i has several neighbours, and we do not observe which one it heeded

stages.name: candidates
stages.claim: each candidate j would pull i by its own lambda k(|d_j|) d_j

stages.name: mixture
stages.claim: selection j_e ~ U(neighbours of i) makes the update a mixture over candidates

stages.name: observed
stages.claim: the observed update delta_e is most likely under one source: inference recovers P(j_e = j | delta_e)
